  100  module6_correct <- function(s) {
  101    out <- module_dir(s, 6); d <- load_module(s, 5); X <- d$X; meta <- d$meta; cc <- s$correct
  102    if (cc$normalization == "PQN") {
  103      f <- pqn_factors(X); X <- X / f
  104      log_msg(sprintf("  PQN: факторы разведения %.2f–%.2f", min(f), max(f)))
  105    }
  106    L0 <- if (isTRUE(cc$log2)) log2(X) else X
  107    info <- list(normalization = cc$normalization, log2 = isTRUE(cc$log2), method = cc$method)
  108    if (cc$method == "eigenms") {
  109      e <- eigenms(L0, meta$group, cc$eigen_perm, cc$eigen_alpha, s$project$seed + 6)
  110      L <- e$L; info$n_trends <- e$n_trends
  111      log_msg(sprintf("  EigenMS: найдено и удалено трендов систематической ошибки: %d (перестановок %d)", e$n_trends, cc$eigen_perm))
  112      write_csv(data.frame(trend = seq_along(e$p), var_explained = e$var_explained, p = e$p), file.path(out, "eigenms_trends.csv"))
  113    } else L <- L0
  114    save_fig(s, patchwork::wrap_plots(sample_boxplot(L0, meta, "(a) до коррекции"), sample_boxplot(L, meta, "(b) после коррекции"), ncol = 1),
  115             out, "distribution_by_sample", 24, 14)
  116    write_csv(data.frame(sample = rownames(L), group = meta$group, as.data.frame(L), check.names = FALSE), file.path(out, "corrected_log2.csv"))
  117    write_csv(as.data.frame(info), file.path(out, "correct_info.csv"))
  118    save_module(s, 6, list(L = L, L_raw = L0, info = d$info, meta = meta, correct = info))
  119  }

==================== R/m7_select.R ====================
    1  # Модуль 7. Статистика и отбор признаков (гибридный алгоритм этапа 1, исправленный):
    2  # ОСФ (одномерный статистический фильтр) → 4 модели caret → частота встречаемости (СПФ) → РОП (RFE).
    3  # Поправка на множественные сравнения — по всем признакам, метод — параметр (по умолчанию Холм).
    4  # Вложенная кросс-валидация повторяет весь отбор внутри обучающих блоков и даёт несмещённую оценку.
    5  
    6  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ ОСФ
    7  uvf <- function(L, groups, p_adjust = "holm", alpha = 0.05) {
    8    g <- factor(groups); k <- nlevels(g)
    9    st1 <- p_adjust == "stage1"
   10    safe <- function(expr) tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) NA_real_)
   11    res <- lapply(seq_len(ncol(L)), function(j) {
   12      v <- L[, j]
   13      p_norm <- if (st1) safe(stats::shapiro.test(v)$p.value)                       # как на этапе 1: по всей выборке
   14                else min(vapply(levels(g), function(l) { x <- v[g == l]; if (length(x) < 3 || stats::sd(x) == 0) NA_real_ else safe(stats::shapiro.test(x)$p.value) }, 0), na.rm = TRUE)
   15      if (!is.finite(p_norm)) p_norm <- 0
   16      p_hom <- safe(stats::bartlett.test(v, g)$p.value); if (is.na(p_hom)) p_hom <- 0
   17      test <- if (p_norm < 0.05) "Уилкоксон" else if (p_hom < 0.05) "Уэлч" else "Стьюдент"
   18      pin <- if (st1) "BH" else "holm"                                                 # поправка между парами групп (k > 2)
   19      p <- if (k == 2) {
   20        a <- v[g == levels(g)[1]]; b <- v[g == levels(g)[2]]
   21        switch(test, "Уилкоксон" = safe(stats::wilcox.test(a, b, exact = FALSE)$p.value),
   22               "Уэлч" = safe(stats::t.test(a, b, var.equal = FALSE)$p.value), "Стьюдент" = safe(stats::t.test(a, b, var.equal = TRUE)$p.value))
   23      } else {
   24        pm <- switch(test, "Уилкоксон" = safe(stats::pairwise.wilcox.test(v, g, p.adjust.method = pin, exact = FALSE)$p.value),
   25                     "Уэлч" = safe(stats::pairwise.t.test(v, g, p.adjust.method = pin, pool.sd = FALSE)$p.value),
   26                     "Стьюдент" = safe(stats::pairwise.t.test(v, g, p.adjust.method = pin, pool.sd = TRUE)$p.value))
   27        min(pm, na.rm = TRUE)
   28      }
   29      c(p_norm = p_norm, p_homog = p_hom, p = p, test = match(test, c("Уилкоксон", "Уэлч", "Стьюдент")))
   30    })
   31    r <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, res)); r$id <- colnames(L)
   32    r$test <- c("Уилкоксон", "Уэлч", "Стьюдент")[r$test]
   33    r$p_adj <- if (p_adjust %in% c("stage1", "none")) r$p else stats::p.adjust(r$p, p_adjust)
   34    r$selected <- !is.na(r$p_adj) & r$p_adj <= alpha
   35    if (k == 2) r$log2FC <- colMeans(L[g == levels(g)[2], , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(L[g == levels(g)[1], , drop = FALSE])
   36    r[, c("id", setdiff(names(r), "id"))]
   37  }
   38  
   39  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ модели caret и частота встречаемости
   40  nb_funcs <- function() {                       # наивный байесовский классификатор (e1071) для caret::rfe
   41    f <- caret::rfFuncs
   42    f$fit <- function(x, y, first, last, ...) e1071::naiveBayes(x, y)
   43    f$pred <- function(object, x) {
   44      pr <- stats::predict(object, x, type = "raw")
   45      data.frame(pred = factor(colnames(pr)[max.col(pr, ties.method = "first")], levels = colnames(pr)), pr, check.names = FALSE)
   46    }
   47    f$rank <- function(object, x, y) {
   48      v <- caret::filterVarImp(x, y); v$Overall <- rowMeans(v)
   49      v <- v[order(v$Overall, decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]; v$var <- rownames(v); v
   50    }
   51    f
   52  }
   53  
   54  train_models <- function(df, s, seed) {
   55    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(caret))       # knn3, plsda и др. вызываются caret без префикса
   56    sl <- s$select
   57    B <- sl$cv_folds * sl$cv_repeats
   58    fits <- list()
   59    for (m in sl$models) {
   60      ctrl <- caret::trainControl(method = "repeatedcv", number = sl$cv_folds, repeats = sl$cv_repeats,
   61                                  seeds = caret_seeds(B, max(sl$tune_length, 25), seed + match(m, sl$models)))
   62      fits[[m]] <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(caret::train(Label ~ ., data = df, method = m, metric = "Accuracy",
   63                                                          trControl = ctrl, tuneLength = sl$tune_length)),
   64                            error = function(e) { log_msg("    модель ", m, " не обучена: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
   65    }
   66    fits[!vapply(fits, is.null, TRUE)]
   67  }
   68  
   69  top_features <- function(fit, n) {
   70    imp <- caret::varImp(fit, scale = FALSE)$importance
   71    rownames(imp) <- gsub("`", "", rownames(imp))
   72    imp$sum <- rowSums(imp)
   73    utils::head(rownames(imp)[order(-imp$sum)], n)
   74  }
   75  
   76  run_rfe <- function(df, s, seed) {
   77    sl <- s$select; x <- df[, -1, drop = FALSE]; y <- df$Label
   78    sizes <- seq_len(ncol(x)); B <- sl$rfe_folds * sl$rfe_repeats
   79    set.seed(seed)
   80    seeds <- c(lapply(seq_len(B), function(i) sample.int(1e6, length(sizes) + 1)), list(sample.int(1e6, 1)))
   81    ctrl <- caret::rfeControl(functions = if (sl$rfe_method == "nb") nb_funcs() else caret::rfFuncs, method = "repeatedcv",
   82                              number = sl$rfe_folds, repeats = sl$rfe_repeats, seeds = seeds, verbose = FALSE)
   83    suppressWarnings(caret::rfe(x, y, sizes = sizes, metric = "Accuracy", rfeControl = ctrl))
   84  }
   85  
   86  # Весь отбор: ОСФ → модели → частота → РОП. Возвращает признаки каждого шага.
   87  select_features <- function(L, groups, s, seed, verbose = TRUE) {
   88    sl <- s$select; say <- function(...) if (verbose) log_msg(...)
   89    u <- uvf(L, groups, sl$p_adjust, sl$alpha)
   90    f_uvf <- u$id[u$selected]
   91    say(sprintf("  ОСФ (поправка: %s, α = %g): %d из %d признаков", sl$p_adjust, sl$alpha, length(f_uvf), ncol(L)))
   92    out <- list(uvf = u, f_uvf = f_uvf, f_spf = f_uvf, f_rfe = f_uvf, fits = list(), freq = NULL, rfe = NULL)
   93    if (length(f_uvf) < 2) { say("  Меньше двух признаков после ОСФ: модели и РОП пропущены"); return(out) }
   94    df <- data.frame(Label = factor(groups), L[, f_uvf, drop = FALSE], check.names = FALSE)
   95    out$fits <- train_models(df, s, seed)
   96    tops <- lapply(out$fits, top_features, n = sl$top_n)
   97    freq <- sort(table(unlist(tops)), decreasing = TRUE)                  # частота встречаемости (вместо tuple::tuplicated)
   98    out$freq <- data.frame(id = names(freq), n_models = as.integer(freq), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
   99    out$f_spf <- out$freq$id[out$freq$n_models >= min(sl$min_freq, length(out$fits))]
  100    say(sprintf("  СПФ (в top-%d не менее чем у %d из %d моделей): %d признаков", sl$top_n, sl$min_freq, length(out$fits), length(out$f_spf)))
  101    if (length(out$f_spf) < 2) { out$f_rfe <- out$f_spf; return(out) }
  102    out$rfe <- run_rfe(data.frame(Label = factor(groups), L[, out$f_spf, drop = FALSE], check.names = FALSE), s, seed + 100)
  103    out$f_rfe <- caret::predictors(out$rfe)                              # ds_rfe собирается из результата RFE
  104    say(sprintf("  РОП (%s): %d признаков, точность CV %.3f", if (sl$rfe_method == "nb") "наивный Байес" else "случайный лес",
  105                length(out$f_rfe), max(out$rfe$results$Accuracy)))
  106    out
  107  }
  108  
  109  mean_auroc <- function(L, groups) {           # средняя AUROC отдельных признаков (описательная, как на этапе 1)
  110    v <- caret::filterVarImp(as.data.frame(L), factor(groups))
  111    mean(rowMeans(v))
  112  }
  113  
  114  auc_binary <- function(y, score) {
  115    r <- rank(score); n1 <- sum(y == 1); n0 <- sum(y == 0)
  116    (sum(r[y == 1]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n0)
  117  }
  118  
  119  # Вложенная кросс-валидация: отбор признаков и классификатор обучаются только на обучающем блоке
  120  nested_cv <- function(L, groups, s, seed) {
  121    sl <- s$select; g <- factor(groups); lev <- levels(g)
  122    pred <- list(); chosen <- list(); k <- 0
  123    for (r in seq_len(sl$nested_repeats)) {
  124      set.seed(seed + r)
  125      folds <- integer(length(g))
  126      for (l in lev) { i <- which(g == l); folds[i[sample.int(length(i))]] <- rep_len(seq_len(sl$nested_folds), length(i)) }
  127      for (f in seq_len(sl$nested_folds)) {
  128        k <- k + 1; te <- folds == f; tr <- !te
  129        sel <- select_features(L[tr, , drop = FALSE], g[tr], s, seed + 1000 * r + f, verbose = FALSE)
  130        feats <- sel$f_rfe; chosen[[k]] <- feats
  131        prob <- if (length(feats) == 0) matrix(rep(as.numeric(table(g[tr]) / sum(tr)), each = sum(te)), sum(te), dimnames = list(NULL, lev))
  132        else if (sl$rfe_method == "nb") stats::predict(e1071::naiveBayes(L[tr, feats, drop = FALSE], g[tr]), L[te, feats, drop = FALSE], type = "raw")
  133        else { set.seed(seed + k); stats::predict(randomForest::randomForest(L[tr, feats, drop = FALSE], g[tr]), L[te, feats, drop = FALSE], type = "prob") }
  134        pred[[k]] <- data.frame(repeat_ = r, fold = f, sample = rownames(L)[te], truth = g[te],
  135                                predicted = lev[max.col(prob, ties.method = "first")], prob, check.names = FALSE)
  136        log_msg(sprintf("    вложенная CV: повтор %d, блок %d — признаков %d", r, f, length(feats)))
  137      }
  138    }
  139    P <- do.call(rbind, pred)
  140    per_rep <- lapply(split(P, P$repeat_), function(d) c(accuracy = mean(d$predicted == d$truth),
  141                                                       auc = if (length(lev) == 2) auc_binary(as.integer(d$truth == lev[2]), d[[lev[2]]]) else NA))
  142    M <- do.call(rbind, per_rep)
  143    fr <- sort(table(unlist(chosen)), decreasing = TRUE)
  144    list(predictions = P,
  145         summary = data.frame(outer_folds = sl$nested_folds, repeats = sl$nested_repeats, input = sl$nested_input,
  146                              accuracy_mean = mean(M[, "accuracy"]), accuracy_sd = if (nrow(M) > 1) stats::sd(M[, "accuracy"]) else NA,
  147                              auc_mean = mean(M[, "auc"]), auc_sd = if (nrow(M) > 1) stats::sd(M[, "auc"]) else NA,
  148                              mean_n_features = mean(lengths(chosen))),
  149         frequency = data.frame(id = names(fr), share_of_folds = as.numeric(fr) / k, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  150  }
  151  
  152  # Необязательно: модель с ковариатами (пол, возраст), если они есть в метаданных и групп две
  153  covariate_model <- function(L, meta) {
  154    g <- factor(meta$group); if (nlevels(g) != 2 || is.null(meta$sex) || is.null(meta$age)) return(NULL)
  155    D <- data.frame(group = as.numeric(g == levels(g)[2]), sex = as.numeric(meta$sex == "M"), age = meta$age)
  156    ok <- stats::complete.cases(D); if (sum(ok) < 10) return(NULL)
  157    D <- D[ok, ]; used <- names(D)[vapply(D, stats::sd, 0) > 0]
  158    Xd <- cbind(1, as.matrix(D[, used, drop = FALSE])); Y <- L[ok, , drop = FALSE]
  159    XtX <- solve(crossprod(Xd)); b <- XtX %*% crossprod(Xd, Y); res <- Y - Xd %*% b; dof <- nrow(Xd) - ncol(Xd)
  160    se <- sqrt(colSums(res^2) / dof * XtX[2, 2]); p <- 2 * stats::pt(abs(b[2, ] / se), dof, lower.tail = FALSE)
  161    data.frame(id = colnames(L), log2FC_adjusted = b[2, ], p = p, p_BH = stats::p.adjust(p, "BH"), covariates = paste(used[-1], collapse = "+"))
  162  }
  163  
  164  module7_select <- function(s) {
  165    out <- module_dir(s, 7); d <- load_module(s, 6); sl <- s$select
  166    meta <- d$meta; g <- factor(meta$group); info <- d$info
  167    ann <- function(df) merge(info[, c("id", "mz", "rt_min", "name")], df, by = "id", sort = FALSE)
  168    cl <- register_cores(s$project$cores); on.exit(stop_cores(cl))
  169    sel <- select_features(d$L, g, s, s$project$seed + 7)
  170    write_csv(ann(sel$uvf[order(sel$uvf$p), ]), file.path(out, "uvf_stats.csv"))
  171    tab <- function(f) data.frame(sample = rownames(d$L), Label = g, d$L[, f, drop = FALSE], check.names = FALSE)
  172    write_csv(tab(sel$f_uvf), file.path(out, "ds.csv")); write_csv(tab(sel$f_spf), file.path(out, "ds_d.csv"))
  173    write_csv(tab(sel$f_rfe), file.path(out, "ds_rfe.csv"))
  174    if (!is.null(sel$freq)) write_csv(ann(sel$freq), file.path(out, "feature_frequency.csv"))
  175    if (!is.null(sel$rfe)) write_csv(sel$rfe$results, file.path(out, "rfe_profile.csv"))
  176    acc <- data.frame()
  177    addacc <- function(fits, set) for (m in names(fits))
  178      acc <<- rbind(acc, data.frame(dataset = set, model = m, n_features = length(fits[[m]]$coefnames),
  179                                    accuracy_cv = mean(fits[[m]]$resample$Accuracy), accuracy_sd = stats::sd(fits[[m]]$resample$Accuracy)))
  180    addacc(sel$fits, "ds (после ОСФ)")
  181    if (isTRUE(sl$compare_stages)) {
  182      log_msg("  Точность моделей на всех признаках до и после коррекции (сравнение этапов)…")
  183      addacc(train_models(data.frame(Label = g, d$L_raw, check.names = FALSE), s, s$project$seed + 71), "ds_raw (до коррекции)")
  184      addacc(train_models(data.frame(Label = g, d$L, check.names = FALSE), s, s$project$seed + 72), "dsr (после коррекции)")
  185    }
  186    if (nrow(acc)) { write_csv(acc, file.path(out, "model_accuracy.csv"))
  187      for (i in seq_len(nrow(acc))) log_msg(sprintf("    %s, %s: точность CV %.3f", acc$dataset[i], acc$model[i], acc$accuracy_cv[i])) }
  188    steps <- data.frame(dataset = c("ds_raw (до коррекции)", "dsr (после коррекции)", "ds (после ОСФ)", "ds_d (после СПФ)", "ds_rfe (после РОП)"),
  189                        n_features = c(ncol(d$L_raw), ncol(d$L), length(sel$f_uvf), length(sel$f_spf), length(sel$f_rfe)))
  190    steps$mean_auroc_descriptive <- c(mean_auroc(d$L_raw, g), mean_auroc(d$L, g),
  191                                      vapply(list(sel$f_uvf, sel$f_spf, sel$f_rfe), function(f) if (length(f)) mean_auroc(d$L[, f, drop = FALSE], g) else NA, 0))
  192    write_csv(steps, file.path(out, "auroc_steps.csv"))
  193    log_msg("  Число признаков и средняя AUROC по этапам (описательная): ",
  194            paste(sprintf("%d (%.3f)", steps$n_features, steps$mean_auroc_descriptive), collapse = " → "))
  195    nest <- NULL
  196    if (isTRUE(sl$nested_cv)) {
  197      log_msg(sprintf("  Вложенная кросс-валидация (%d блоков × %d повтора, данные: %s)…", sl$nested_folds, sl$nested_repeats,
  198                      if (sl$nested_input == "imputed") "после заполнения пропусков, без EigenMS" else "после EigenMS — оценка завышена"))
  199      nest <- nested_cv(if (sl$nested_input == "imputed") d$L_raw else d$L, g, s, s$project$seed + 700)
  200      write_csv(nest$summary, file.path(out, "nested_cv.csv")); write_csv(nest$predictions, file.path(out, "nested_cv_predictions.csv"))
  201      write_csv(ann(nest$frequency), file.path(out, "nested_cv_feature_frequency.csv"))
  202      log_msg(sprintf("  Вложенная CV: точность %.3f, AUC %.3f (несмещённая оценка всей процедуры отбора)", nest$summary$accuracy_mean, nest$summary$auc_mean))
  203    }
  204    cov <- covariate_model(d$L_raw, meta)
  205    if (!is.null(cov)) { write_csv(ann(cov[order(cov$p), ]), file.path(out, "covariate_model.csv"))
  206      log_msg(sprintf("  Модель с поправкой на %s: q(BH) < 0,05 у %d признаков", cov$covariates[1], sum(cov$p_BH < 0.05))) }
  207    save_module(s, 7, list(L = d$L, L_raw = d$L_raw, info = info, meta = meta, sel = sel[c("uvf", "f_uvf", "f_spf", "f_rfe", "freq")],
  208                           rfe_results = if (!is.null(sel$rfe)) sel$rfe$results, accuracy = acc, steps = steps, nested = nest, covariate = cov))
  209  }

==================== R/m8_visual.R ====================
    1  # Модуль 8. Визуализация: PCA и иерархическая кластеризация (Манхэттен, Уорд) на трёх этапах обработки,
    2  # тепловая карта, диаграммы размаха по метаболитам, PLS-DA с VIP. PNG/JPEG с разрешением из настроек.
    3  
    4  feature_label <- function(info, ids) {
    5    i <- match(ids, info$id)
    6    ifelse(nzchar(info$name[i]) & info$name[i] != "Unknown", substr(info$name[i], 1, 28),
    7           ifelse(is.na(info$mz[i]), ids, sprintf("m/z %.4f @ %.2f min", info$mz[i], info$rt_min[i])))
    8  }
    9  
   10  draw_dendrogram <- function(L, groups, title, s) {
   11    hc <- stats::hclust(stats::dist(L, method = s$visual$hca_distance), method = s$visual$hca_method)
   12    cols <- group_colors(groups); gi <- stats::setNames(as.character(groups), rownames(L))
   13    dd <- stats::dendrapply(stats::as.dendrogram(hc), function(n) {
   14      if (stats::is.leaf(n)) attr(n, "nodePar") <- list(lab.col = cols[gi[attr(n, "label")]], pch = NA, lab.cex = 0.35)
   15      n })
   16    graphics::par(mar = c(3, 3, 2, 0.5), cex.main = 0.9)
   17    plot(dd, main = title, ylab = "")
   18    k <- length(unique(groups))
   19    stats::rect.hclust(hc, k = k, border = "grey40")
   20    graphics::legend("topright", legend = names(cols), text.col = cols, bty = "n", cex = 0.7)
   21  }
   22  
   23  vip_pls <- function(m) {
   24    W <- m$loading.weights; Tt <- m$scores; Q <- m$Yloadings
   25    SS <- colSums(Tt^2) * colSums(matrix(Q^2, ncol = ncol(W)))
   26    Wn <- sweep(W, 2, sqrt(colSums(W^2)), "/")
   27    drop(sqrt(nrow(W) * (Wn^2 %*% SS) / sum(SS)))
   28  }
   29  
   30  module8_visual <- function(s) {
   31    out <- module_dir(s, 8); d <- load_module(s, 7); v <- s$visual
   32    meta <- d$meta; g <- meta$group; info <- d$info; sel <- d$sel
   33    sets <- list("A — до коррекции" = d$L_raw, "B — после коррекции" = d$L,
   34                 "C — после отбора (ОСФ+СПФ+РОП)" = d$L[, sel$f_rfe, drop = FALSE])
   35    pcs <- lapply(names(sets), function(n) if (ncol(sets[[n]]) >= 2) pca_plot(sets[[n]], g, n) else
   36      ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "менее двух признаков") + ggplot2::theme_void() + ggplot2::labs(title = n))
   37    save_fig(s, patchwork::wrap_plots(pcs, nrow = 1), out, "pca_stages", 26, 9)
   38    save_base_fig(s, function() { graphics::par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
   39      for (n in names(sets)) if (ncol(sets[[n]]) >= 1) draw_dendrogram(sets[[n]], g, n, s) }, out, "hca_stages", 30, 11)
   40    hf <- if (length(sel$f_spf) >= 2) sel$f_spf else utils::head(sel$uvf$id[order(sel$uvf$p)], v$heatmap_top)
   41    hf <- utils::head(hf, v$heatmap_top)
   42    M <- t(scale(d$L[, hf, drop = FALSE])); rownames(M) <- make.unique(feature_label(info, hf)); M[M > 3] <- 3; M[M < -3] <- -3
   43    ann <- data.frame(group = g, row.names = rownames(d$L))
   44    save_base_fig(s, function() pheatmap::pheatmap(M, annotation_col = ann, show_colnames = FALSE, fontsize_row = 5,
   45      clustering_distance_cols = v$hca_distance, clustering_method = v$hca_method, annotation_colors = list(group = group_colors(g)),
   46      color = grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(101), main = "Heatmap: z-score, Ward"), out, "heatmap", 18, 16)
   47    bf <- unique(c(sel$f_rfe, utils::head(sel$uvf$id[order(sel$uvf$p)], v$boxplot_top)))[seq_len(min(v$boxplot_top, ncol(d$L)))]
   48    bd <- do.call(rbind, lapply(bf, function(f) data.frame(name = feature_label(info, f), value = d$L[, f], group = g)))
   49    bd$name <- factor(bd$name, levels = unique(bd$name))
   50    bp <- ggplot2::ggplot(bd, ggplot2::aes(group, value, fill = group)) + ggplot2::geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
   51      ggplot2::geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.5) + ggplot2::facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
   52      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors(g), guide = "none") + ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "log2 интенсивность") + theme_um() +
   53      ggplot2::theme(strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6))
   54    save_fig(s, bp, out, "boxplots_metabolites", 17, 4.5 * ceiling(length(bf) / 4) + 1)
   55    Y <- stats::model.matrix(~ factor(g) - 1); Xs <- scale(d$L)
   56    m <- pls::plsr(Y ~ Xs, ncomp = 2, scale = FALSE, method = if (ncol(Xs) > nrow(Xs)) "widekernelpls" else "kernelpls")
   57    vip <- vip_pls(m); vt <- utils::head(order(-vip), v$vip_top)
   58    vd <- data.frame(name = factor(feature_label(info, colnames(d$L)[vt]), levels = rev(make.unique(feature_label(info, colnames(d$L)[vt])))), vip = vip[vt])
   59    vd$name <- factor(make.unique(as.character(vd$name)), levels = rev(make.unique(as.character(vd$name))))
   60    pv <- ggplot2::ggplot(vd, ggplot2::aes(vip, name)) + ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "#0072B2") + ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2) +
   61      ggplot2::labs(x = "VIP", y = NULL, title = "PLS-DA: важность переменных (VIP)") + theme_um()
   62    sc <- data.frame(t1 = m$scores[, 1], t2 = m$scores[, 2], group = g)
   63    ps <- ggplot2::ggplot(sc, ggplot2::aes(t1, t2, colour = group)) + ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.6) + ggplot2::stat_ellipse(level = 0.95) +
   64      ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = group_colors(g)) + ggplot2::labs(x = "Компонента 1", y = "Компонента 2", colour = NULL, title = "PLS-DA: счета (описательно)") + theme_um()
   65    save_fig(s, patchwork::wrap_plots(ps, pv, nrow = 1, widths = c(1, 1.2)), out, "plsda_vip", 24, 10)
   66    write_csv(merge(info[, c("id", "mz", "rt_min", "name")], data.frame(id = colnames(d$L), vip = vip), by = "id")[order(-vip), ], file.path(out, "plsda_vip.csv"))
   67    log_msg(sprintf("  Рисунки: PCA и ИКА по трём этапам, тепловая карта (%d признаков), диаграммы размаха (%d), PLS-DA/VIP; форматы: %s, %d dpi",
   68                    length(hf), length(bf), paste(v$formats, collapse = ", "), v$dpi))
   69    save_module(s, 8, list(figures = list.files(out, pattern = "\\.(png|jpg)$")))
   70  }

==================== R/m9_report.R ====================
    1  # Модуль 9. База метаболомных признаков (CSV с дозаписью) и отчёт HTML (R Markdown; без pandoc —
    2  # встроенный генератор HTML) со всеми таблицами, рисунками, журналом и sessionInfo().
    3  
    4  db_append <- function(df, path) {
    5    if (file.exists(path)) {
    6      h <- names(data.table::fread(path, nrows = 0))
    7      if (!identical(h, names(df))) stop("Структура базы ", path, " не совпадает с текущей версией — укажите другую папку базы")
    8      data.table::fwrite(df, path, append = TRUE)
    9    } else data.table::fwrite(df, path, bom = TRUE)
   10  }
   11  
   12  module9_report <- function(s) {
   13    out <- module_dir(s, 9); d <- load_module(s, 7)
   14    run_id <- .ue$run_id %||% format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
   15    # ---------------- база признаков
   16    db <- project_path(s, s$report$database); dir.create(db, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
   17    m3 <- load_module(s, 3); m4 <- load_module(s, 4)
   18    u <- d$sel$uvf; ids <- colnames(d$L)
   19    ft <- data.frame(run_id = run_id, date = format(Sys.Date()), project = s$project$name, id = ids,
   20                     d$info[match(ids, d$info$id), c("mz", "rt_min", "name")],
   21                     rsd_qc = m3$filter$rsd_qc[match(ids, m3$filter$id)] %||% NA,
   22                     p_uvf = u$p[match(ids, u$id)], p_adj = u$p_adj[match(ids, u$id)],
   23                     log2FC = if (!is.null(u$log2FC)) u$log2FC[match(ids, u$id)] else NA,
   24                     selected_uvf = ids %in% d$sel$f_uvf,
   25                     n_models = if (!is.null(d$sel$freq)) d$sel$freq$n_models[match(ids, d$sel$freq$id)] else NA,
   26                     selected_spf = ids %in% d$sel$f_spf, selected_rfe = ids %in% d$sel$f_rfe,
   27                     nested_share = if (!is.null(d$nested)) d$nested$frequency$share_of_folds[match(ids, d$nested$frequency$id)] else NA)
   28    inten <- data.frame(run_id = run_id, sample = rep(rownames(m4$X), ncol(m4$X)), group = rep(m4$meta$group, ncol(m4$X)),
   29                        id = rep(colnames(m4$X), each = nrow(m4$X)),
   30                        mz = rep(d$info$mz[match(colnames(m4$X), d$info$id)], each = nrow(m4$X)),
   31                        rt_min = rep(d$info$rt_min[match(colnames(m4$X), d$info$id)], each = nrow(m4$X)),
   32                        intensity_raw = as.vector(m4$X), log2_corrected = as.vector(d$L[rownames(m4$X), colnames(m4$X)]))
   33    runs <- data.frame(run_id = run_id, date = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), project = s$project$name, version = UROMETABR_VERSION,
   34                       input = basename(if (s$input$type == "table") s$input$table_file else s$input$raw_dir),
   35                       n_samples = nrow(d$L), groups = paste(sprintf("%s:%d", names(table(d$meta$group)), table(d$meta$group)), collapse = " "),
   36                       n_features = ncol(d$L), n_uvf = length(d$sel$f_uvf), n_spf = length(d$sel$f_spf), n_rfe = length(d$sel$f_rfe),
   37                       p_adjust = s$select$p_adjust, seed = s$project$seed)
   38    db_append(runs, file.path(db, "runs_db.csv")); db_append(ft, file.path(db, "features_db.csv")); db_append(inten, file.path(db, "intensities_db.csv"))
   39    log_msg(sprintf("  База признаков (%s): добавлено %d признаков, %d значений интенсивности (прогон %s)", db, nrow(ft), nrow(inten), run_id))
   40    # ---------------- отчёт
   41    sec <- report_sections(s, run_id)
   42    saveRDS(sec, file.path(out, "report_sections.rds"))
   43    f <- file.path(out, "report.html")
   44    rendered <- FALSE
   45    if (isTRUE(s$report$rmarkdown) && requireNamespace("rmarkdown", quietly = TRUE) && rmarkdown::pandoc_available()) {
   46      tpl <- file.path(getOption("urometabr.root", "."), "templates", "report.Rmd")
   47      rendered <- tryCatch({
   48        rmarkdown::render(tpl, output_file = "report.html", output_dir = out, intermediates_dir = tempdir(),
   49                          params = list(sections = file.path(out, "report_sections.rds")), quiet = TRUE, envir = new.env())
   50        TRUE }, error = function(e) { log_msg("  R Markdown недоступен (", conditionMessage(e), ") — встроенный генератор HTML"); FALSE })
   51    }
   52    if (!rendered) write_html(sec, f)
   53    log_msg("  Отчёт: ", f, if (rendered) " (R Markdown)" else " (встроенный генератор)")
   54    save_module(s, 9, list(report = f, database = db, run_id = run_id))
   55  }
   56  
   57  # Содержание отчёта: список разделов (текст, таблицы, рисунки) — общий для R Markdown и встроенного HTML
   58  report_sections <- function(s, run_id) {
   59    P <- function(id, f) file.path(s$project$dir, MODULES$dir[MODULES$id == id], f)
   60    rd <- function(id, f) if (file.exists(P(id, f))) as.data.frame(data.table::fread(P(id, f), encoding = "UTF-8")) else NULL
   61    img <- function(id, f) { p <- P(id, paste0(f, ".png")); if (file.exists(p)) p else NULL }
   62    logs <- file.path(s$project$dir, "logs")
   63    lastf <- function(pat) { f <- sort(list.files(logs, pattern = pat, full.names = TRUE)); if (length(f)) utils::tail(f, 1) else NULL }
   64    m7 <- load_module(s, 7)
   65    sec <- list(
   66      list(title = "Сведения о прогоне", text = c(sprintf("%s. Версия %s (%s).", PROGRAM_NAME, UROMETABR_VERSION, UROMETABR_DATE),
   67             sprintf("Проект: %s; папка: %s; прогон %s; seed %s.", s$project$name, s$project$dir, run_id, s$project$seed)),
   68           tables = list("Время и память по модулям" = if (!is.null(lastf("^modules_"))) as.data.frame(data.table::fread(lastf("^modules_"), encoding = "UTF-8")))),
   69      list(title = "0. Входные данные", tables = list("Проверки" = rd(0, "input_check.csv"))),
   70      list(title = "2. Контроль качества", tables = list("Сводка" = rd(2, "qc_summary.csv"), "Пропуски по группам" = rd(2, "missing_by_group.csv")),
   71           images = c(img(2, "pca_qc"), img(2, "tic_by_order"), img(2, "rsd_qc"))),
   72      list(title = "3. Фильтр устойчивых признаков", tables = list("Шаги фильтрации" = rd(3, "filter_steps.csv"))),
   73      list(title = "5. Заполнение пропусков", tables = list(rd(5, "impute_info.csv"))),
   74      list(title = "6. Коррекция сигнала", tables = list(rd(6, "correct_info.csv")), images = img(6, "distribution_by_sample")),
   75      list(title = "7. Статистика и отбор признаков",
   76           text = "Средняя AUROC по этапам — описательная величина (признаки отобраны по тем же данным). Несмещённая оценка — вложенная кросс-валидация.",
   77           tables = list("Число признаков и средняя AUROC по этапам" = rd(7, "auroc_steps.csv"), "Точность моделей (кросс-валидация)" = rd(7, "model_accuracy.csv"),
   78                         "Вложенная кросс-валидация" = rd(7, "nested_cv.csv"),
   79                         "Признаки после РОП" = { x <- rd(7, "uvf_stats.csv"); if (!is.null(x)) x[x$id %in% m7$sel$f_rfe, ] },
   80                         "ОСФ: 30 признаков с наименьшими p" = utils::head(rd(7, "uvf_stats.csv"), 30),
   81                         "Модель с поправкой на пол и возраст (30 первых)" = utils::head(rd(7, "covariate_model.csv"), 30))),
   82      list(title = "8. Визуализация", images = c(img(8, "pca_stages"), img(8, "hca_stages"), img(8, "heatmap"), img(8, "boxplots_metabolites"), img(8, "plsda_vip"))),
   83      list(title = "9. База признаков", text = sprintf("Записи добавлены в %s (runs_db.csv, features_db.csv, intensities_db.csv).", project_path(s, s$report$database))),
   84      list(title = "Журнал прогона", pre = if (!is.null(.ue$log_file)) readLines(.ue$log_file, encoding = "UTF-8")),
   85      list(title = "sessionInfo()", pre = utils::capture.output(utils::sessionInfo())))
   86    sec
   87  }
   88  
   89  html_esc <- function(x) { x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x); x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x); gsub(">", "&gt;", x) }
   90  html_tab <- function(d) {
   91    if (is.null(d) || !nrow(d)) return("")
   92    f <- function(v) if (is.numeric(v)) formatC(v, digits = 4, format = "g") else html_esc(as.character(v))
   93    rows <- apply(as.data.frame(lapply(d, f)), 1, function(r) paste0("<tr><td>", paste(r, collapse = "</td><td>"), "</td></tr>"))
   94    paste0("<table><tr><th>", paste(html_esc(names(d)), collapse = "</th><th>"), "</th></tr>", paste(rows, collapse = ""), "</table>")
   95  }
   96  write_html <- function(sec, f) {
   97    body <- vapply(sec, function(x) {
   98      tb <- if (length(x$tables)) paste(vapply(seq_along(x$tables), function(i) {
   99        nm <- names(x$tables)[i]; paste0(if (!is.null(nm) && nzchar(nm)) paste0("<h4>", html_esc(nm), "</h4>") else "", html_tab(x$tables[[i]])) }, ""), collapse = "") else ""
  100      im <- paste(vapply(x$images %||% character(0), function(p)
  101        sprintf("<img src=\"data:image/png;base64,%s\"/>", jsonlite::base64_enc(readBin(p, "raw", file.info(p)$size))), ""), collapse = "")
  102      paste0("<h2>", html_esc(x$title), "</h2>", paste0("<p>", html_esc(x$text %||% character(0)), "</p>", collapse = ""), tb, im,
  103             if (length(x$pre)) paste0("<pre>", html_esc(paste(x$pre, collapse = "\n")), "</pre>") else "")
  104    }, "")
  105    css <- "body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;max-width:1100px;margin:20px auto;padding:0 16px}table{border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px}td,th{border:1px solid #ccc;padding:2px 6px}th{background:#eee}img{max-width:100%;margin:8px 0}pre{background:#f6f6f6;padding:8px;font-size:11px;white-space:pre-wrap}"
  106    writeLines(c("<!doctype html><html lang=\"ru\"><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><title>Отчёт UroMetabR</title><style>", css, "</style></head><body>",
  107                 paste0("<h1>Отчёт о прогоне UroMetabR ", UROMETABR_VERSION, "</h1>"), body, "</body></html>"), f, useBytes = TRUE)
  108  }

==================== R/zz_setup.R ====================
    1  # Пакеты и загрузка модулей утилиты.
    2  
    3  REQUIRED_PACKAGES <- c("data.table", "yaml", "ggplot2", "patchwork", "pheatmap", "caret", "e1071", "kernlab",
    4                         "randomForest", "pls", "foreach", "doParallel", "jsonlite", "shiny", "rmarkdown", "knitr")
    5  OPTIONAL_PACKAGES <- c(xcms = "Bioconductor: обработка mzML/mzXML/CDF (модуль 1)", MSnbase = "Bioconductor: чтение сырых данных (модуль 1)",
    6                         IPO = "Bioconductor: оптимизация параметров xcms (модуль 1)", missForest = "CRAN: альтернативная реализация заполнения пропусков")
    7  
    8  missing_packages <- function() REQUIRED_PACKAGES[!vapply(REQUIRED_PACKAGES, requireNamespace, TRUE, quietly = TRUE)]
    9  
   10  install_missing <- function(repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org") {
   11    miss <- missing_packages()
   12    if (length(miss)) { message("Установка пакетов: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", ")); utils::install.packages(miss, repos = repos) }
   13    miss <- missing_packages()
   14    if (length(miss)) stop("Не удалось установить: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
   15    invisible(TRUE)
   16  }
   17  
   18  load_urometabr <- function(root) {
   19    if (!isTRUE(l10n_info()$`UTF-8`))
   20      for (loc in c("C.UTF-8", "en_US.UTF-8", "ru_RU.UTF-8", "Russian_Russia.utf8")) if (nzchar(suppressWarnings(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", loc)))) break
   21    options(urometabr.root = normalizePath(root, winslash = "/"), urometabr.dir = file.path(normalizePath(root, winslash = "/"), "R"))
   22    for (f in sort(list.files(file.path(root, "R"), pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE))) sys.source(f, envir = globalenv(), keep.source = FALSE)
   23    invisible(TRUE)
   24  }

   80  
   81  server <- function(input, output, session) {
   82    rv <- reactiveValues(s = NULL, running = FALSE, started = NULL, msg = "")
   83    observeEvent(input$proj_pick, { d <- pick_dir(); if (!is.na(d)) updateTextInput(session, "proj", value = d)
   84      else showNotification("Выбор папки окном доступен в Windows; введите путь вручную", type = "warning") })
   85    for (k in c("table", "meta")) local({ kk <- k
   86      observeEvent(input[[paste0(kk, "_pick")]], { f <- pick_file(); if (length(f) && !is.na(f)) updateTextInput(session, paste0(kk, "_file"), value = f)
   87        else showNotification("Выбор файла окном доступен в Windows; введите путь или загрузите файл", type = "warning") })
   88      observeEvent(input[[paste0(kk, "_up")]], {
   89        req(rv$s); up <- input[[paste0(kk, "_up")]]; d <- file.path(rv$s$project$dir, "input"); dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE)
   90        f <- file.path(d, up$name); file.copy(up$datapath, f, overwrite = TRUE); updateTextInput(session, paste0(kk, "_file"), value = f) }) })
   91    observeEvent(input$raw_pick, { d <- pick_dir(); if (!is.na(d)) updateTextInput(session, "raw_dir", value = d) })
   92  
   93    fill_ui <- function(s) {
   94      upd <- function(id, v) updateNumericInput(session, id, value = v)
   95      updateTextInput(session, "pname", value = s$project$name); upd("seed", s$project$seed); upd("cores", s$project$cores)
   96      updateRadioButtons(session, "in_type", selected = s$input$type)
   97      updateTextInput(session, "table_file", value = s$input$table_file); updateTextInput(session, "meta_file", value = s$input$metadata_file)
   98      updateTextInput(session, "raw_dir", value = s$input$raw_dir)
   99      upd("f_rsd", s$filter$max_qc_rsd); upd("f_grp", s$filter$min_group_detect); upd("f_qc", s$filter$min_qc_detect); upd("f_blank", s$filter$blank_ratio)
  100      updateSelectInput(session, "imp", selected = s$impute$method); upd("imp_iter", s$impute$maxiter); upd("imp_tree", s$impute$ntree)
  101      updateSelectInput(session, "norm", selected = s$correct$normalization); updateSelectInput(session, "corr", selected = s$correct$method); upd("eig_perm", s$correct$eigen_perm)
  102      updateSelectInput(session, "padj", selected = s$select$p_adjust); upd("alpha", s$select$alpha)
  103      updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "models", selected = s$select$models); upd("top_n", s$select$top_n); upd("min_freq", s$select$min_freq)
  104      updateSelectInput(session, "rfe", selected = s$select$rfe_method); updateCheckboxInput(session, "nested", value = isTRUE(s$select$nested_cv))
  105      upd("n_folds", s$select$nested_folds); upd("n_rep", s$select$nested_repeats); upd("dpi", s$visual$dpi)
  106      updateCheckboxGroupInput(session, "fmt", selected = s$visual$formats); updateTextInput(session, "db", value = s$report$database)
  107      upd("x_ppm", s$xcms$ppm); upd("x_pw1", s$xcms$min_peakwidth); upd("x_pw2", s$xcms$max_peakwidth); upd("x_minfrac", s$xcms$min_fraction)
  108      updateCheckboxInput(session, "x_ipo", value = isTRUE(s$xcms$ipo))
  109    }
  110    collect <- function() {
  111      s <- rv$s
  112      s$project$name <- input$pname; s$project$seed <- input$seed; s$project$cores <- input$cores
  113      s$input$type <- input$in_type; s$input$table_file <- input$table_file; s$input$metadata_file <- input$meta_file; s$input$raw_dir <- input$raw_dir
  114      s$filter$max_qc_rsd <- input$f_rsd; s$filter$min_group_detect <- input$f_grp; s$filter$min_qc_detect <- input$f_qc; s$filter$blank_ratio <- input$f_blank
  115      s$impute$method <- input$imp; s$impute$maxiter <- input$imp_iter; s$impute$ntree <- input$imp_tree
  116      s$correct$normalization <- input$norm; s$correct$method <- input$corr; s$correct$eigen_perm <- input$eig_perm
  117      s$select$p_adjust <- input$padj; s$select$alpha <- input$alpha; s$select$models <- input$models; s$select$top_n <- input$top_n
  118      s$select$min_freq <- input$min_freq; s$select$rfe_method <- input$rfe; s$select$nested_cv <- input$nested
  119      s$select$nested_folds <- input$n_folds; s$select$nested_repeats <- input$n_rep
  120      s$visual$dpi <- input$dpi; s$visual$formats <- input$fmt; s$report$database <- input$db
  121      s$xcms$ppm <- input$x_ppm; s$xcms$min_peakwidth <- input$x_pw1; s$xcms$max_peakwidth <- input$x_pw2
  122      s$xcms$min_fraction <- input$x_minfrac; s$xcms$ipo <- input$x_ipo
  123      s$run$from <- as.integer(input$from); s$run$to <- as.integer(input$to)
  124      s
  125    }
  126    save_s <- function() { s <- collect(); check_settings(s); write_settings(s, s$settings_file); rv$s <- read_settings(s$settings_file); rv$s }
  127  
  128    observeEvent(input$proj_open, {
  129      d <- trimws(input$proj); if (!nzchar(d)) { showNotification("Укажите папку проекта", type = "error"); return() }
  130      dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE); f <- file.path(d, "settings.yaml")
  131      if (!file.exists(f)) write_settings(default_settings(), f)
  132      rv$s <- tryCatch(read_settings(f), error = function(e) { showNotification(conditionMessage(e), type = "error"); NULL })
  133      if (!is.null(rv$s)) fill_ui(rv$s)
  134    })
  135    output$proj_status <- renderText(if (is.null(rv$s)) "Проект не открыт" else paste("Открыт проект:", rv$s$project$dir, "— настройки:", rv$s$settings_file))
  136    observeEvent(input$save, { req(rv$s); r <- tryCatch({ save_s(); "Настройки сохранены" }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e)); output$save_status <- renderText(r) })
  137    observeEvent(input$check, {
  138      req(rv$s); s <- tryCatch(save_s(), error = function(e) { showNotification(conditionMessage(e), type = "error"); NULL }); req(s)
  139      log_start(s); r <- tryCatch({ module0_input(s); NULL }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
  140      if (!is.null(r)) { showNotification(r, type = "error", duration = NULL); output$check_tab <- renderTable(data.frame(Ошибка = r)) }
  141      else output$check_tab <- renderTable(utils::read.csv(file.path(s$project$dir, "00_input", "input_check.csv"), encoding = "UTF-8", check.names = FALSE))
  142    })
  143    observeEvent(input$run, {
  144      req(rv$s); if (rv$running) return()
  145      s <- tryCatch(save_s(), error = function(e) { showNotification(conditionMessage(e), type = "error"); NULL }); req(s)
  146      rs <- file.path(R.home("bin"), if (is_win) "Rscript.exe" else "Rscript")
  147      rv$started <- Sys.time(); rv$running <- TRUE
  148      system2(rs, c(shQuote(file.path(root, "run_analysis.R")), shQuote(s$settings_file), paste0("--from=", input$from), paste0("--to=", input$to)),
  149              wait = FALSE, stdout = file.path(s$project$dir, "logs", "console.txt"), stderr = file.path(s$project$dir, "logs", "console.txt"))
  150      updateTabsetPanel(session, "tabs", "3. Запуск")
  151    })
  152    latest <- function(pat) { if (is.null(rv$s)) return(NULL); f <- list.files(file.path(rv$s$project$dir, "logs"), pattern = pat, full.names = TRUE)
  153      if (!length(f)) return(NULL); f <- f[order(file.info(f)$mtime)]; if (!is.null(rv$started)) f <- f[file.info(f)$mtime >= rv$started - 1]
  154      if (length(f)) utils::tail(f, 1) else NULL }
  155    log_now <- reactivePoll(1000, session, function() { f <- latest("^run_.*\\.log$"); if (is.null(f)) 0 else file.info(f)$mtime },
  156                            function() { f <- latest("^run_.*\\.log$"); if (is.null(f)) character(0) else readLines(f, encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE) })
  157    observe({ l <- log_now(); if (rv$running && any(grepl("UROMETABR_DONE|Обработка остановлена", l))) rv$running <- FALSE })
  158    output$run_state <- renderText({ l <- log_now()
  159      if (rv$running) "Идёт обработка…" else if (any(grepl("Обработка остановлена", l))) "Остановлено из-за ошибки — см. журнал"
  160      else if (any(grepl("UROMETABR_DONE", l))) "Обработка завершена" else "" })
  161    output$log_text <- renderText(paste(utils::tail(setdiff(log_now(), "UROMETABR_DONE"), 200), collapse = "\n"))
  162    output$mod_tab <- renderTable({ log_now(); f <- latest("^modules_.*\\.csv$"); if (is.null(f)) return(NULL)
  163      d <- utils::read.csv(f, encoding = "UTF-8", check.names = FALSE)
  164      stats::setNames(d, c("Модуль", "Название", "Статус", "Время, с", "Пиковая память R, МБ")) }, na = "")
  165    rd <- function(id, f) { log_now(); req(rv$s); p <- file.path(rv$s$project$dir, MODULES$dir[MODULES$id == id], f)
  166      if (file.exists(p)) utils::read.csv(p, encoding = "UTF-8", check.names = FALSE) }
  167    output$res_steps <- renderTable(rd(7, "auroc_steps.csv"), digits = 3)
  168    output$res_nested <- renderTable(rd(7, "nested_cv.csv"), digits = 3)
  169    output$res_rfe <- renderTable({ u <- rd(7, "uvf_stats.csv"); r <- rd(7, "ds_rfe.csv"); if (!is.null(u) && !is.null(r)) u[u$id %in% names(r), c("id", "mz", "rt_min", "name", "test", "p", "p_adj")] }, digits = 4, na = "")
  170    observe({ log_now(); req(rv$s); f <- list.files(file.path(rv$s$project$dir, c("02_qc", "06_correct", "08_visual")), pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
  171      updateSelectInput(session, "fig", choices = stats::setNames(f, basename(f))) })
  172    output$fig_img <- renderImage({ req(input$fig); list(src = input$fig, width = "100%") }, deleteFile = FALSE)
  173    observeEvent(input$open_report, { req(rv$s); f <- file.path(rv$s$project$dir, "09_report", "report.html")
  174      if (file.exists(f)) utils::browseURL(f) else showNotification("Отчёт ещё не сформирован", type = "warning") })
  175    observeEvent(input$open_dir, { req(rv$s); if (is_win) shell.exec(rv$s$project$dir) else utils::browseURL(rv$s$project$dir) })
  176  }
  177  
  178  shinyApp(ui, server)

==================== app/launch.R ====================
    1  # Запуск графического интерфейса: проверка/установка пакетов и открытие окна в браузере.
    2  if (!isTRUE(l10n_info()$`UTF-8`) && .Platform$OS.type != "windows")      # кириллица в модулях: UTF-8
    3    for (loc in c("C.UTF-8", "en_US.UTF-8", "ru_RU.UTF-8")) if (nzchar(suppressWarnings(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", loc)))) break
    4  self <- sub("^--file=", "", grep("^--file=", commandArgs(), value = TRUE)[1])
    5  root <- normalizePath(file.path(dirname(normalizePath(self)), ".."))
    6  source(file.path(root, "R", "zz_setup.R"), encoding = "UTF-8")
    7  if (length(missing_packages())) install_missing()
    8  load_urometabr(root)
    9  port <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("UROMETABR_PORT", "0")); if (!port) port <- NULL
   10  shiny::runApp(file.path(root, "app"), launch.browser = Sys.getenv("UROMETABR_NO_BROWSER") == "", port = port)

==================== templates/report.Rmd ====================
    1  ---
    2  title: "Отчёт о прогоне UroMetabR"
    3  output:
    4    html_document:
    5      self_contained: true
    6      toc: true
    7      toc_float: false
    8  params:
    9    sections: ""
   10  ---
   11  
   12  ```{r setup, include = FALSE}
   13  knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
   14  sec <- readRDS(params$sections)
   15  ```
   16  
   17  ```{r body, results = "asis"}
   18  for (x in sec) {
   19    cat("\n\n## ", x$title, "\n\n", sep = "")
   20    for (t in x$text) cat(t, "\n\n")
   21    if (length(x$tables)) for (i in seq_along(x$tables)) {
   22      d <- x$tables[[i]]; nm <- names(x$tables)[i]
   23      if (is.null(d) || !nrow(d)) next
   24      if (!is.null(nm) && nzchar(nm)) cat("**", nm, "**\n\n", sep = "")
   25      print(knitr::kable(d, digits = 4, format = "html", table.attr = "class='table table-condensed' style='font-size:12px'"))
   26      cat("\n\n")
   27    }
   28    for (p in x$images) cat("![](", p, ")\n\n", sep = "")
   29    if (length(x$pre)) cat("```\n", paste(x$pre, collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")
   30  }
   31  ```

==================== Start_UroMetabR.bat ====================
    1  @echo off
    2  chcp 65001 >nul
    3  cd /d "%~dp0"
    4  set "RS="
    5  for /f "delims=" %%i in ('where Rscript 2^>nul') do if not defined RS set "RS=%%i"
    6  if not defined RS for /d %%d in ("%ProgramFiles%\R\R-*") do if exist "%%d\bin\Rscript.exe" set "RS=%%d\bin\Rscript.exe"
    7  if not defined RS (
    8    echo R не найден. Установите R версии 4.0.0 или новее: https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/
    9    pause
   10    exit /b 1
   11  )
   12  echo Запуск UroMetabR: "%RS%"
   13  "%RS%" --vanilla app\launch.R
   14  if errorlevel 1 pause

==================== start_urometabr.sh ====================
    1  #!/bin/sh
    2  # Запуск графического интерфейса UroMetabR (Linux, macOS)
    3  cd "$(dirname "$0")" && Rscript --vanilla app/launch.R

==================== Create_desktop_shortcut.vbs ====================
    1  Set sh = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
    2  d = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject").GetParentFolderName(WScript.ScriptFullName)
    3  Set lnk = sh.CreateShortcut(sh.SpecialFolders("Desktop") & "\UroMetabR.lnk")
    4  lnk.TargetPath = d & "\Start_UroMetabR.bat"
    5  lnk.WorkingDirectory = d
    6  lnk.Description = "UroMetabR"
    7  lnk.Save
    8  MsgBox "Shortcut UroMetabR created on Desktop"
